mcqs.question: Which two histologic phenotypes of diffuse alveolar haemorrhage does the review name?

options.A: Capillaritis and a bland non-inflammatory phenotype

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Capillaritis and a bland non-inflammatory phenotype
mcqs.explanation: The review distinguishes capillaritis and a bland non-inflammatory phenotype.

sourceRefs.excerpt: capillaritis and a bland non-inflammatory phenotype

mcqs.question: Over what time course does the review say haemoptysis and symptoms of DAH may develop?

options.B: Several years of stable mild cough only

mcqs.explanation: Symptoms, including haemoptysis, can develop rapidly in hours or over a few days.

sourceRefs.excerpt: hemoptysis, with symptoms developing rapidly in hours or over a few days

mcqs.question: Besides SLE, which groups does the review say are susceptible to DAH?

options.A: ANCA vasculitides, and patients with antiphospholipid syndrome can develop DAH

mcqs.correctAnswerText: ANCA vasculitides, and patients with antiphospholipid syndrome can develop DAH
mcqs.explanation: The disorder is more common in ANCA vasculitides, and patients with APS can develop DAH.

sourceRefs.excerpt: the disorder is more common in ANCA-vasculitides and patients with APS can develop DAH

mcqs.question: When is DAH risk increased in the SLE discussion?

options.A: During active renal disease, especially lupus nephritis
options.B: Only in cutaneous lupus in remission
options.C: Only after the kidneys have recovered for a decade
options.E: Only in drug-induced lupus from statins, which the paper does not discuss

mcqs.correctAnswerText: During active renal disease, especially lupus nephritis
mcqs.explanation: An increased risk is reported during active renal disease, especially lupus nephritis.

sourceRefs.excerpt: increased risk of DAH has been reported during active renal disease, especially when manifesting as lupus nephritis

mcqs.question: Which sampling fluid does the review discuss in the DAH work-up?

options.C: Pleural fluid as the only sample

mcqs.explanation: Bronchoalveolar lavage fluid is discussed; the paper notes some findings may appear only after several days.
